paragraphs.source_en:
The Examiner for 22 August 1819 reprinted an address which the Female Reformers of
Manchester had intended to make to Henry Hunt at the meeting of 16 August as they presented him
with a new banner. It includes the injunction: ‘May your flag never be unfurled but in the cause of
peace and reform, and then may a female’s curse pursue the coward who deserts the standard’ (543).
 [Ye whom Death cannot subdue/Cowards] Every child will Nbk 10 f. 22r.
